headlines.title: Hurricane Isaias leaves at least two people dead
headlines.description: At least two people were killed after Hurricane Isaias made landfall on the Florida Panhandle as a Category 2 storm. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch and Angie Lassman report.

headlines.title: Trump says he’ll decide whether to livestream the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he hasn’t yet made a final decision on whether to livestream the execution of former Army Maj.

headlines.title: Shooter kills 8 at family home in Pennsylvania before turning gun on self, Erie police say
headlines.description: A man killed seven family members and a family friend at a home in Erie, Pennsylvania, on Friday night before dying of an apparent self-inflicted gunshot wound, officials said.

headlines.title: Can you trust the vote?
headlines.description: Pennsylvania’s top election official explains how claims of voter fraud make it harder to make the vote secure

headlines.title: Mail ballot concerns are changing how Democrats vote
headlines.description: Democrats are changing how they vote, requesting fewer mail ballots than in past elections but returning the ones they do request more quickly, according to a new NBC News Decision Desk analysis of the early vote conducted in coordination with the University of Pennsylvania.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.
